dns_description: Bypasses ISP blocks for the catalog and TV guide. Video uses the device's DNS: to protect it too, turn on encrypted DNS in the device settings ("Private DNS" on Android).
connections_desc: Streams in use on your subscription / maximum allowed by your provider (as of the last source sign-in)
latin_only_desc: Hide Arabic, Asian, Hebrew scripts, etc.
dashboard_default_mode_desc: Mode shown when opening the Dashboard
m3u_link: M3U playlist link or Xtream link
m3u_hint: Paste your M3U playlist address (often ending in .m3u or .m3u8) or an Xtream link http://host:port/get.php?username=...&password=...
m3u_source_url_hint: Paste the address given by your provider (it often ends with .m3u or .m3u8). A Dispatcharr M3U output works too.
m3u_source_epg_hint: An XMLTV guide. Leave empty if the playlist already names its own.
tmdb_title_search_desc: When the provider or the M3U playlist does not give the TMDB number of a movie or series, the app finds its details from the title and year, and only keeps reliable matches. This also fills the Suggestions page. When off, details already found from titles are removed (they come back if you turn it on again) and the provider's own images and texts are kept.
m3u_source_error_invalid_url: The playlist address must start with http:// or https://.
m3u_source_error_invalid_epg_url: The guide address must start with http:// or https://.
m3u_source_error_too_long: These addresses are too long to be saved on this computer.
iptv_error_desc: We are detecting instability with the playlist source. Some content may be inaccessible at the moment. Please try refreshing or check with your provider.
iptv_warning_desc: We are detecting instability with the playlist source. Some content may be inaccessible at the moment. Please try refreshing or check with your provider.
iptv_too_large_desc: A list from your provider is abnormally large: it was not loaded, to protect the app. Part of the catalogue is missing. Please contact your provider.
tmdb_split: {{provider}}% from the provider, {{title}}% found by title
confirm_clear_cache:
Do you really want to reset ALL data? (Cache, My List, Playback positions, Preferences)

You will be logged out.
session_desc: Logging out will return you to the login screen. Data remains saved locally.
confirm_logout: Do you really want to log out?
about_desc: Premium Desktop IPTV application with TMDB enrichment and cinematic experience.
tmdb_attribution: This product uses the TMDB API but is not endorsed or certified by TMDB.
zapping_desc: Play directly when clicking a channel
m3u_manager_desc: Manage multiple IPTV sources, merge playlists and configure per-source preferences.
error_credentials_rejected: Your provider rejected the username or password. Please check them and try again.
error_invalid_m3u: Invalid link: it must start with http:// or https://.
reset_select_options: Select what you want to clear:
purge_cloud_data_hint: Removes My List, your playback positions, TV favorites, hidden categories and preferences from the cloud. Your Nyx account and profile are kept.
reset_cloud_purge_failed: Deleting your cloud data failed (network or server). Nothing was erased on this device; part of the cloud data may have been. Please try again.
reset_cloud_purge_no_session: Your cloud data could not be deleted: you are no longer signed in to your Nyx account. Nothing was erased. Sign in again, or untick “Also delete my cloud data”.
account_sync_refused: Some of your data could not be synced: the server refused a value that was too large. It stays on this device.
account_email_invalid: Please enter a valid email address.
account_email_change_sent: A confirmation email has been sent to your new address. After confirming, log out and log back in with your new email to see the change.
account_password_min_length: Password must be at least 10 characters.
account_delete_warning: This will permanently delete your account and all your data. This action cannot be undone.
account_delete_unconfirmed: The server's answer did not arrive: your account may already have been deleted. The app will check at next launch; if it was not, you can try again.
report_bug_desc: Found a bug? Describe it below. The app version will be included automatically.
hardware_acceleration_desc: Uses the GPU for rendering and video decoding. Disable if you experience display issues.
hardware_acceleration_restart_msg: This change requires an application restart. Restart now?
epg_toggle_desc: Shows current programs on channel cards.
epg_wifi_only_desc: The guide is about 205 MB: automatic updates wait for a Wi-Fi connection.
epg_sync_error: EPG sync failed. Please try again.
epg_disable_message: TV guide data will be deleted.
auto_refresh_desc: Every 12 hours, in the background, never during a video or on a metered mobile connection. New titles appear when you switch tabs.
auto_refresh_never: Not refreshed on this device yet
auto_refresh_failed: Last attempt failed, will retry later.
auto_refresh_advice: The provider removed many titles: press Refresh to confirm.
licenses_intro_android: Video player: libmpv and FFmpeg, built as LGPL and shipped as replaceable libraries.
licenses_intro_desktop: Video player: mpv (mpv.exe), a separate open source program launched by the app.
guest_card_title: You are using Nyx without an account
guest_card_text: Your favourites, resume points and settings stay on this device. They are not shared with your other devices.
guest_account_later: For now, signing in or creating an account does not take this device's data along: it stays here, and you get it back by choosing “Continue without an account”. Moving it into an account will come in a later version.
guest_tmdb_paused: TMDB details paused until {{time}}: today's limit is reached. Meanwhile, Nyx shows your provider's images and summaries.
guest_reset_text: Removes your provider, favourites, resume points and settings from this device. The app restarts on the welcome screen.
guest_confirm_reset:
Do you really want to erase ALL the data on this device? (provider, cache, My List, resume points, settings)

The app restarts on the welcome screen.
